page.notes: Left column, last paragraph: the text "Nazaraeos appellarunt, Fuit enim hæc Naza-" is at the foot and continues into the right column as "razorum hæresis...", which I have joined. The right column's last line is cut off at the edge of the scan. The word "Christumque" is printed with a hyphen after "Chri-" at the line end, so I kept it as "Chri-stumque". The printing of "Visisunt" and "Eusebias" is unclear. Lower part of the page is cut off; the final words are cut short. Several words in the small notes are uncertain and may be misread.
